interpretation.environment: local PostgreSQL, synthetic Discord, 256 MiB/no swap/1 CPU; no production latency inference
interpretation.queueWaitMs: receipt commit acknowledgement to initial claim acknowledgement, including claim command
interpretation.claimToCompleteMs: initial claim acknowledgement to final part commit acknowledgement, including cooperative yield and requeue
interpretation.dispatchDurations: wake or release to next claim command; includes capacity wait and empty claims
interpretation.databaseDurations: client wall time; not isolated server execution, pool wait, network RTT, or lock wait
interpretation.memory: cgroup peak includes warmup; raw sampling and recorder memory are included
interpretation.comparisons: all optimizations combined; no isolated causal attribution to SQL, fairness, HTTP, or wake
